description: This file defines extension mechanisms for pandas-on-Spark, including custom accessors registration for DataFrame, Series, and Index objects, and includes a test function for the extension module.

classes.name: CachedAccessor
classes.description: A descriptor class for caching pandas-on-Spark accessors, parameterized by name and accessor class.

methods.name: _register_accessor
methods.description: Internal function to register a custom accessor on pandas-on-Spark objects (DataFrame, Series, Index).

methods.name: register_dataframe_accessor
methods.description: Decorator to register a custom accessor for pandas-on-Spark DataFrame objects.

methods.name: register_series_accessor
methods.description: Decorator to register a custom accessor for pandas-on-Spark Series objects.

methods.name: register_index_accessor
methods.description: Decorator to register a custom accessor for pandas-on-Spark Index objects.

methods.name: _test
methods.description: Function to run doctests on the extension module, setting up a Spark session and environment.
